answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 2103 Country: India Title: What is authencity of shabe baarat it is right to cook good meal on that day and light candles etc? Question: What is authencity of shabe baarat it is right to cook good meal on that day and light candles etc? Answer ID: 2103 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 535/535=L) Several traditions of the Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) indicate the virtue of this night; therefore the scholars of Fiqh have mentioned that it is desirable to offer prayers in this night: ومن المندوبات ۔۔ احیاء لیلۃ العیدین والنصف من شعبان الخ (الدر المختار مع الشامی: 2/469) But, cooking good food and lighting candles on this occasion is nothing, it has no base in Islam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
